embedding_evaluation.note: The benchmark inserts text and metadata only. Semantic/hybrid probes stop at the missing-stored-embeddings check; no vectors are fabricated and no provider is called.

limitations: The 256 generated positive queries, 16 no-match queries, 192 same-scope near-miss chunks, and remaining scope distractors are deterministic synthetic development fixtures, not field/vendor samples or a holdout.

Lexical and metadata modes are measured separately. Semantic and hybrid modes are requested and probed but are not scored because the benchmark has no authentic stored embeddings; lexical fallback is never counted as semantic quality.
No embedding vectors are generated for this corpus and no embedding/LLM provider is called by the benchmark.
Relevance labels are fixture-authored, not independently adjudicated; metrics do not establish semantic correctness, answer quality, or engineering acceptance.
Depth windows use explicit canonical SI metadata; time windows use explicit source periods. Missing metadata is excluded, never inferred from text or created_at.

fallback_notes: vector search unavailable because no stored chunk embeddings are available; fell back to lexical scoring
hybrid.reason: Authentic stored chunk embeddings are unavailable; semantic/hybrid ranking was not scored. The probe records the product fallback separately. No vectors were fabricated and no embedding provider was called by this benchmark.
